name: Oceanic Hearts
source:
Princess Marina needs to be married within three days, and there are only two suitors available at such short notice: the gentle, musically-inclined Queen Delphine and the fun-loving flower-crowner Princess Cora. Marina will have to choose one, but can she fall in love in three days? And who will she give her heart to?

A short visual novel for Yuri Game Jam 2016!

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/oceanic-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽娜公主必须在三天内结婚，而在如此仓促的期限下，只有两位求婚者可供选择：温柔、热爱音乐的德尔芬女王，以及活泼、喜欢为人戴上花冠的科拉公主。玛丽娜必须选出其中一人，可她能在三天内坠入爱河吗？她又会把自己的心交给谁？

一部为Yuri Game Jam 2016制作的短篇视觉小说！

（来源：[url=https://krispycat.itch.io/oceanic-hearts]itch.io[/url]）
